about:
# KrazyPlayerObject
The smaller sister mod to [KrazyPlayLayer](mod:raydeeux.krazyplaylayer). Fine-tune your Geometry Dash gameplay experience even further than you could imagine, this time focusing on the PlayerObject! (Hopefully.)

Options include:
- Using your ball frame of choice even when the vanilla "Default Mini Icon" option is enabled (otherwise giving you a tiny version of the default ball)
- Using your mini cube frame of choice even when the vanilla "Default Mini Icon" option is enabled (in case you somehow prefer playing with a tiny version of the default ball but still want to keep your original icon)
- Use the original clockwise Dash Orb rotation direction regardless of player gravity (restoring behavior from before GD 2.207)
- Run/walk animation overrides for Robot and Spider gamemodes for each gamemode speed ("walk", "run", "run2", "run3")
- Disabling the idle animations for Robot and Spider gamemodes when standing still in Platformer mode
- Using your selected Jetpack icon when entering the Ship portal in Classic levels
- Using your selected Ship icon when entering the Ship portal in Platformer levels
- Pedantic circle colors when using jump pads or gamemode portals (Swing, Spider, Robot, Wave, Red Jump Pad)
- Always-active OR never-active modifier blocks (S/D/H/J/F blocks)
- Disabling player repelling during duals (most often when both players are in the Ball gamemode)
- Overriding when player controls are disabled by Options triggers
- Overriding when players are hidden
- "Locking" the camera position and/or rotation to Player 1
- Never allowing Audio on Death
- Never disabling Death SFX
- Preventing levels from editing respawn time

Also check out KrazyPlayLayer!

<mod:raydeeux.krazyplaylayer>

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.
